subject: Mobile Development
title: App Store Review: The Gatekeepers
description: A short lesson to help you apply App Store Review: The Gatekeepers.

hook.text: You finish building an app. You can't just give it to users. Apple must approve it first.

buildup.text: Apple reviews every app for guidelines compliance, privacy, and content standards.

discovery.text: Reviews typically take 24 to 48 hours. Rejections come with a reason but no negotiation.

twist.text: Google Play's review is faster but catches fewer policy violations before they go live.

climax.text: App review is the choke point between a developer's code and the user's phone.

punchline.text: Every app needs a gatekeeper's approval first.

quiz.question: How long does Apple's app review typically take?
